mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of UNRATE > 6.5% periods, or Rank IC over 3 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days via reduced corporate earnings forecasts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of HOUST and RSAFS decline periods, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth during late-cycle expansions intensifies supply chain pressures, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through inflation expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly periods, or Rank IC over 5 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A six-month rising trend in retail sales consistently boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS six-month rise periods, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales declining more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals consumer sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of RSAFS decline periods, or Rank IC over 5 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and CPI inflation above 2.0% annually signal monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of FEDFUNDS rise and CPI > 2.0% periods, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment below 4.0% combined with monthly job gains exceeding 150k indicates labor market tightness, increasing corporate wage costs and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of tight labor market periods, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
